qualification.repeat: Every first-pass eligible case receives a second original/teacher comparison with the same four layouts and new independent policy-noise slots; same gate must pass again.
qualification.selection: First two twice-qualified cases in fixed case_order; no changing pairs or replacing failed goals.
qualification.competitor: 16 development trials for each selected case before fitting; >=8 strict successes qualifies a preservation claim, otherwise retain as baseline-floor stress test.
qualification.failures: Preserve all receipts, failed source/capture attempts, failed gates, and nonqualifying goals. Incomplete execution stops for inspection, never silently reruns.
qualification.batch_order: Initial original then teacher; repeat teacher then original; fixed case order. Same slots across wordings; different slots across passes.

scoring.placement: Relation/container geometry + table/container contact + gripper detached + mover speed<.02m/s + mover displacement>=.02m + reference maximum displacement<=.02m throughout. Both bins remain fixed.
scoring.pickup: Stock object_picked_up: grabbed and >=.05m above table, plus 1s dwell; no extra stationarity requirement.
scoring.frame: Robot frame, nonmirrored 45-degree cone for behind. Stock named left/right bins.
scoring.endpoint: Selected strict success termination, otherwise30s timeout. Cross-goal final and ever scores recorded separately.
scoring.stock: Stock-compatible instantaneous predicates are secondary; strict placement additionally requires stable contact/reference locality.
scoring.reset: Reject initially true goals, wrong pose writes, >12mm XY settle drift, >5mm recent drift, >3cm/s settle speed; log reset evidence before rejection.

closed_form.pooling: 32 repair image cells averaged over training repair observations; individual preservation keys with mean-per-observation penalty
closed_form.ridge_scale: relative ridge times mean squared norm of repair keys only

live_replay.batch_context: Actual active requests recovered from sealed source observation step arrays

validation.singleton_to_live_difference: Measured diagnostic, not an input-identity gate. BF16 kernels vary with batch/graph shape.

selection.teacher: Initial qualification teacher batch: smallest slot for each of four development layouts; trajectory fractions 0,.25,.5,.75. No outcome filtering.
selection.preservation: Competing batch: two smallest slots for each development layout; fractions 0,.5. No outcome filtering.
selection.split: D01–D03 train, D04 validation: 12repair+12preservation train,4+4 validation.
selection.duplicates: Stop and preserve evidence if a selected trajectory cannot supply distinct indices for every fixed fraction; no replacement or duplicate training inputs.

adaptation.selection_rule: One fixed closed-form recipe. No goal-specific rank/layer/strength search.
adaptation.validation_limit: Replay/parity must pass before evaluation; no claim of repair before heldout comparison.

heldout.saved_rewrite: Conservative text-only grammar recognizes cube-behind or inverse bowl-in-front, glasses pickup synonyms, and mustard-left-bin placement; passes competing, negated, conflicting or uncertain requests unchanged. Rules/vocabulary are engineered with the predeclared unseen test vocabulary. No evaluator case ID, exact test-string lookup, blind or learned generalization claim.
heldout.unseen: Exact phrase withheld from adaptation; no policy testing until candidate freeze. Goals may have appeared historically.
heldout.selection: No heldout-based edit selection or test reruns.

costs.historical: Historical screening informed this cohort; disclosed separately rather than described as fresh discovery.
costs.inherited_runtime: Original runtime source/replay engineering is inherited; original two-case comparison cost remains separate.
costs.measure: Actual per-stage execution and queue wall time; no cold-start speed claim; operator effort not automatically metered.
costs.predecessor_attempts: Separately inventory all32 prior policy episodes,4 glasses simulator starts, server/setup/queue exposure, and interrupted supervisor. Not zero and not part of v2 policy denominator.
costs.preflight: Two starts maximum without policy; measured queue/execution separately from all learned-policy costs.

predecessor.disposition: Interrupted at glasses setup;32 completed cube-behind development episodes; no repeated gate, edit, or heldout test. All attempted costs retained separately.

setup_successor.unchanged: All original XY jitter, X/Z/rotation, other object poses, prompts, scoring, gates, case order, method recipe and episode budgets. Only fresh policy noise and cohort identities otherwise change.
setup_successor.reason: Original cube reset tipped amid tight marker geometry;25mm negative-Y shift removes projected mesh overlap. Not a policy-selected correction.

preflight.stop: Any preflight failure stops; no iterative geometry search or threshold relaxation. All12 geometry layouts require passing both reset cycles before review/qualification.
